summary: Strawberry Fields REIT filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering up to 1,034,940 shares of common stock issuable upon exercise of Series 2 warrants issued September 15, 2026 in a Regulation S offering to Israeli investors. The warrants became exercisable upon listing on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, carry an exercise price of NIS 46 (about $15.12), and expire December 30, 2027, with a floor at the prior-day NYSE American close. The stock closed at $13.93 on September 15, 2026. This is a routine resale/exercise registration, not a special situation.
